title: Nephi's Ship and the Law of Specifics: Virtual Interviews and the Accountability Mindset
summary: Drawing from Preach My Gospel and a classic quote by President Thomas S. Monson, President Hughes establishes that measured performance accelerates personal and spiritual growth. He equates the pandemic's restrictions to Nephi's challenge of facing a vast ocean with no knowledge of shipbuilding (1 Nephi 17), explaining that challenges are designed by God to build capacities. He outlines four steps modeled by Nephi to gain divine solutions and announces that accountability will continue through virtual one-on-one zone interviews and district conferences over Zoom.
